name: dsh-agent-session-tools
description: Agent tools for DeepSeek Harness sessions: create a session, inject queued or steering messages into any session, wait for replies, read output segments, inspect live progress, watch other sessions, and migrate a task to a successor session. 给 DeepSeek Harness Agent 用的会话工具：新建会话、向任意会话注入消息（排队/引导）、等待回复、增量读取输出、查看实时进度、守候其他会话、把任务迁到继任会话。
author: zgq0106 (https://github.com/zgq0106)
